# Kanji Games Implementation Plan

> **For Claude:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task.

**Goal:** Replace the placeholder games hub with three playable, mobile-friendly kanji games, shipped one at a time.

**Architecture:** Zero-build static site. Pure game logic lives in testable ES modules; thin DOM controllers; a dedicated `assets/css/games.css` loaded only on game pages. New external corpora are pre-generated by Python builds and committed under `data/` (not markdown-sourced).

**Tech Stack:** HTML/CSS/vanilla ES modules, Python 3.12+ build scripts, Node 20+ (`node --test`), GitHub Actions.

**Decisions (approved 2026-09-11):**

- Phased: Time Attack → Kanji in Kanji → Quick Compound.
- Time Attack: 4-choice Thai meanings; player selects JLPT/Kanken band; local best + last score.
- Later games: tap-to-select tiles (no Japanese IME).
- Data: commit generated subsets from pinned JMdict/KRADFILE, invariant-tested; excluded from the markdown drift check.

**Rules:** TDD for pure logic, one task per commit, verify before each commit, do not push without asking.

---

## Phase 1 — Games hub + Kanji Time Attack

### Task 1.1 — Games hub

**Files:**

- Modify: `games/index.html`
- Create: `tests/games.test.mjs`

Replace the placeholder cards with: Kanji Time Attack (live → `time-attack.html`), Kanji in Kanji and Quick Compound (disabled "เร็วๆ นี้"). Keep `body data-page="games"`.

Test: one live `hub-card` linking to `time-attack.html`, two `.hub-card.disabled`, and the three titles present.

### Task 1.2 — Time Attack core (TDD)

**Files:**

- Create: `assets/js/games/time-attack-core.js`
- Create: `tests/time-attack.test.mjs`

Pure exports:

- `BANDS` — JLPT N5–N1 plus Kanken stages (elementary, mid, high, univ) with their filter predicates.
- `filterPool(entries, band)` — entries matching the band.
- `pickDistractors(pool, correctMeaning, n, rng)` — distinct Thai meanings, never the answer.
- `makeQuestions(pool, count, rng)` — up to `count` questions with 4 unique options containing the correct one.
- `scoreResult(score, previousBest)`.

Tests first with deterministic injected `rng`: band filtering, 4 distinct options incl. correct, no repeat questions in a round, tiny-pool safety.

### Task 1.3 — Game stats storage

**Files:**

- Modify: `assets/js/storage.js`

Add a `GAMES` key and `getGameStats()` / `saveGameResult(gameId, band, score)` storing `{ best, last }` per game+band.

### Task 1.4 — Page, controller, routing

**Files:**

- Create: `games/time-attack.html` (`data-page="game-time-attack"`)
- Create: `assets/js/games/time-attack.js`
- Modify: `assets/js/main.js`

Flow: band chips → 60 s round → results (score, best, replay). Uses `loadSearchIndex()`. Keyboard 1–4, `aria-live` score, timer bar, instant feedback. `main.js` gets a `game-time-attack` route via dynamic import.

### Task 1.5 — Styling

**Files:**

- Create: `assets/css/games.css`
- Modify: `games/time-attack.html` (link it)

Reuse theme variables; responsive option buttons, timer bar, results card, reduced-motion support.

### Task 1.6 — Verification

`npm test`, `npx markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md"`, `python3 scripts/compile_content.py && git diff --exit-code -- data/`, local play-through at 360/768/desktop, keyboard test.

---

## Phase 2 — Kanji in Kanji

- Data: `scripts/build_components.py` → `data/kanji-components.min.json` from pinned KRADFILE (EDRDG). Filter to our kanji, drop single-component entries. Tests: components are CJK, coverage count, no self-reference.
- Game: target kanji + component tiles (real + decoys); tap valid ones; score + local best.
- `about.html`: add KRADFILE attribution.

## Phase 3 — Quick Compound

- Data: `scripts/build_compounds.py` → `data/compounds.min.json` from pinned JMdict (EDRDG). Filter common entries (`ichi1`/`news1`/`news2`/`spec1`), all kanji within our dataset, length 2–4; per-kanji index.
- Game: target kanji + word bank (valid + decoys); tap valid compounds; show word + reading (+ English gloss; Thai gloss unavailable).
- Tests: word contains target kanji, reading non-empty, dedupe; watch committed size.

## Cross-cutting

- No runtime frameworks/bundlers.
- New data files are generated reference data: documented in `AGENTS.md` as not markdown-drift-checked but unit-tested.
- Service worker already covers `data/` (SWR) and HTML/JS (network-first); bump cache on release if needed.
- Open points per phase: band-chip UX; KRADFILE radical-only components; Quick Compound gloss language and dataset size.
